summary: Validated the async bolletta analysis + broker queue pattern end-to-end. Backend: pytest 13/13 PASS (fast upload <2s with stato='in_elaborazione', polling converges to 'lead_in_attesa' with dati != null, GET /lead/mine not shadowed by /lead/{id}, invalid id -> 400, missing/non-owner -> 404, /lead/{id}/risparmia with unreachable broker returns 200 {ok:true, inviato:false, in_coda:true} and lead becomes 'in_coda_broker' (NO 502), /analizza-macchinario still works and always returns JSON, PRO vs Base 402 gating regression unchanged). Frontend: /analisi-energetica full flow works for logged-in privato (upload -> analisi-loading -> analisi-result with 'Dati estratti dalla bolletta' -> Risparmia Ora -> analisi-success 'Pratica inviata con successo!'); anonymous Hero flow correctly redirects to /registrati (sessionStorage 'analisi_lead_id' used for logged-in handoff).

test_results.backend_analizza_bolletta_fast_in_elabor: PASS (elapsed ~0.3s, stato=in_elaborazione, lead.id present, content-type JSON)
test_results.backend_risparmia_broker_unreachable_in_: PASS (HTTP 200 JSON {ok:true, inviato:false, in_coda:true, messaggio:...}; lead stato -> in_coda_broker)
test_results.frontend_analisi_energetica_full_flow_pr: PASS (upload -> analyzing -> result with 'Dati estratti dalla bolletta' + Risparmia Ora -> 'Pratica inviata con successo!')

critical_code_review_comments: routes_ai.py /lead/{lead_id} is correctly declared AFTER /lead/mine so FastAPI order resolution prevents shadowing — good. Keep this comment/order explicit if someone refactors.

In invia_lead_broker the 'in_coda_broker' path returns a nice JSON but does not persist the user's phone/email snapshot into the lead doc — if admins process the queue later from DB, they must re-join with users. Consider storing a 'contatto_snapshot' on the lead when queued.

/analizza-bolletta reads all files sequentially before enforcing the 15MB total cap — a malicious client could still stream large payloads: consider enforcing Content-Length early or UploadFile size via starlette settings.

AI_TIMEOUT=120s is still enforced per-call inside the BackgroundTask (correct). The frontend poll deadline is 150s, which gives ~30s buffer for Gemini + DB update — adequate but tight for 15MB PDFs; consider raising frontend poll deadline to AI_TIMEOUT+60s.
AnalisiEnergetica.jsx polls every 2.5s with no exponential backoff — fine at scale now, but worth adding backoff if the page gets heavy traffic.
Hero.jsx anonymous flow shows a toast then navigates to /registrati but it does NOT persist the pending files (user has to re-upload after signup). Minor UX gap — acceptable for MVP.

rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validated the fix. Previously /api/analizza-bolletta ran Gemini synchronously in-request (8-15s typical, up to 30s+ on PDFs) and the Cloudflare gateway killed the connection at ~100s with 520/504 before Gemini responded, giving the user a generic 'formato PDF' error. Fix pattern (verified working): (1) POST returns immediately after inserting a lead with stato='in_elaborazione' and queues the Gemini call via FastAPI BackgroundTasks; (2) GET /api/lead/{id} is the polling endpoint, placed AFTER /lead/mine so the literal route is not shadowed; (3) /lead/{id}/risparmia catches httpx broker failures and returns 200 {in_coda:true} + notify_admins instead of propagating 502. Frontend AnalisiEnergetica.jsx polls every 2.5s with a 150s deadline; Hero.jsx hands off the lead id via sessionStorage 'analisi_lead_id'.
